text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, a computer learns from training data that includes correct answers. For example, you can show a computer many pictures of cats and dogs with labels. The computer builds a model from this data. Later, when you give it a new picture, the model makes a prediction: cat or dog. The accuracy of the model shows how often its predictions are correct. More training data usually helps the model make better predictions and achieve higher accuracy.
